paper_title: TRUTH DECAY Quantifying Multi-Turn Sycophancy in Language Models
caption: entropyavggraphstatic.png

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average entropy values across different sycophancy reduction methods for various AI models under static experiments. The horizontal axis categorizes the different AI models labeled as GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. These categories are evenly spaced with a categorical scale. The vertical axis represents "Entropy Average Values", with a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, marked at intervals of 0.5 units. The chart includes three bars for each AI model, representing different methods: Baseline, Source Info, and Direct Command. Each method is assigned a distinct color—Baseline is pink, Source Info is yellow, and Direct Command is blue. For GPT-4, the entropy values are approximately 4.8, 5.2, and 5.0 for Baseline, Source Info, and Direct Command respectively. Claude has values around 4.6, 5.2, and 5.0. Llama shows approximate values of 4.5, 5.0, and 4.9. The bars are grouped by AI model and visually arranged side-by-side for each category. There is no indication of sorting or visual emphasis, such as shading or annotations, among the bars. A text is given top of chart "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments". A legend is given top right.
